name: Dagang NeXchange Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告以股份上市/分拆类公司行动为主，另有若干「OTHERS」公告但未附内文，无法确认具体业务变化；最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长8.4%，净利润同比增长33.2%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements were mainly corporate actions related to additional listing/subdivision of shares, along with several 'OTHERS' announcements without attached content, so specific business changes cannot be confirmed; in the latest quarter (30 June 2026), revenue grew 8.4% year-on-year and net profit grew 33.2% year-on-year.
